messages:
maria (Support): forwarding from @acme-admin — users cannot SSO into app since cert rotation. They say they updated IdP metadata ~2h ago. Our SP logs show: 'AssertionConsumerServiceURL mismatch' for several requests. Case S-38012. Pasting customer's metadata and SAMLResponse below.

acme-admin (Customer): hey, just rotated our idp cert and uploaded metadata. now users get a login error. works if we remove the trailing slash from our ACS, hope that helps. here's metadata: https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml

jamal (SRE): thx. can you paste a failing SAMLResponse (base64) or relay a request-id from our logs? also confirm SP vs IdP initiated.

maria (Support): customer says SP-initiated. they pasted the base64 string to the case. i decoded it with samltool and assertion shows ACS Location = 'https://app.acme.example/saml/acs' (NO trailing slash). our SP is configured with 'https://app.acme.example/saml/acs/' (WITH trailing slash).

sophie (Eng - SAML): that'll do it — our default ACS matching is an exact string match. trailing slash mismatch will cause a reject. two things to check in parallel: the ACS URL mismatch and the cert/hash algorithm they rotated to. sometimes IdPs rotate to a cert with a different signature algorithm (sha1 vs sha256) and our validation rejects it.

jamal (SRE): grabbing metadata now:
```
curl -fsSL https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml -o /tmp/acme-metadata.xml
xmllint --xpath "//md:AssertionConsumerService/@Location" /tmp/acme-metadata.xml 2>/dev/null || true
```
Output shows one ACS entry with Location='https://app.acme.example/saml/acs' (no slash). KeyDescriptor present with base64 cert. pulling cert -> checking fingerprint:
```
# extract cert and check fingerprint
xmllint --xpath "string(//ds:KeyInfo/ds:X509Data/ds:X509Certificate)" /tmp/acme-metadata.xml | sed -E 's/(.{64})/\1\n/g' > /tmp/idp.crt.pem
openssl x509 -noout -text -in /tmp/idp.crt.pem | grep "Signature Algorithm"
openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256 -in /tmp/idp.crt.pem
```
The cert's signature alg shows 'sha1WithRSAEncryption' in the cert (old). that may be rejected by our more strict validators.

sophie (Eng - SAML): confirmed — we intentionally block SHA1 signed metadata for new orgs (security policy). If IdP re-published metadata with SHA256 cert that should fix it. BUT even with cert fixed they'll still fail because of ACS mismatch (trailing slash). Quick options:
- short term: Support can add a second ACS entry in our SP config for this org with the non-slash URL (we accept multiple ACS entries per org).
- short term 2: have customer update their IdP metadata to include ACS with trailing slash OR set the ACS index to the one matching SP config.
- medium term: Eng can implement relaxed ACS compare (normalize trailing slashes) or accept equivalent URLs. I'll open an internal ticket.

maria (Support): can we do the support-side change right now? customer asking for immediate fix.

jamal (SRE): we can add alternate ACS mapping via admin UI for the org. Steps in support runbook:
1) Support console -> Organizations -> select Acme Corp -> SSO settings -> Advanced -> Add alternate ACS URL -> paste 'https://app.acme.example/saml/acs' -> save.
2) inform customer to retry full logout/login.

sophie (Eng - SAML): i'll open SAML-412 (P1) to track the code change to normalize ACS matching and to add tests for metadata with/without trailing slash. include a regression test for signature alg acceptance (reject SHA1). If we relax matching we must ensure no security regression.

eng-saml-bot: Deployment check scheduled for SAML-412: staging job created, build #786 queued. :gear:

jamal (SRE): also, for the cert: customer rotated to an old sha1-signed cert by mistake? ask them to provide metadata again. sample message to customer we can paste:
"Can you re-publish your IdP metadata ensuring the x509 certificate is SHA256-signed and that an AssertionConsumerService entry exists for 'https://app.acme.example/saml/acs/' (with trailing slash)? As a temporary workaround we can add the non-slash ACS to your SP configuration on our side."

maria (Support): pasted that to the case. customer replied they will re-generate metadata with a sha256 cert within 30m. they also asked us to apply the support-side workaround while they redo cert. i've scheduled the alternate ACS entry change.

sophie (Eng - SAML): noted. for the internal ticket I'll include repro steps so QA can verify:
1) generate metadata with ACS '.../saml/acs' and cert signed with SHA256 -> expect success.
2) generate metadata with ACS missing trailing slash -> expect failure currently.
3) metadata with SHA1 cert -> expect rejection.
Include logs snippet:
```
[auth] SAML Assertion rejected: assertion consumer service mismatch: got 'https://app.acme.example/saml/acs' expected 'https://app.acme.example/saml/acs/'
[auth] Signature verification failed: unsupported signature algorithm sha1WithRSAEncryption
```
maria (Support): summary / next steps:
- Support: added alternate ACS mapping for Acme (done). case S-38012 updated.
- Customer: re-publish metadata with SHA256 cert (they're on it).
- Eng (sophie): SAML-412 opened to implement normalized ACS compare + tests.
- SRE (jamal): monitor for any remaining failures and send logs.
I'll mark case P1 and keep customer updated. :white_check_mark:

acme-admin (Customer): thanks everyone — trying regen now, will update in 20m.

maria (Support): closing loop for now, will reopen if errors persist.
